source.description:
PROBLEM
tsconfig.json has include: ["src/**/*"] and excludes only node_modules and dist. No file under tests/ is typechecked. `bunx tsc --noEmit` reports clean while a test file calls a method that does not exist on the class it imports.

This is not hypothetical. The acceptance AX live case in tests/integration/activation/native-activation.live.test.ts called `host.snapshot(activationId)` at two places from the day it was written. NativeActivationHost has no `snapshot` member; the method is `inspect()` (src/activation/native-host.ts:732). The case could never pass — it threw `TypeError: host.snapshot is not a function` before reaching any assertion — and this was found only by running the live suite on 2026-09-07 during unitAI-rrdnt.35. A self-diagnosing failure block added to that same case shortly before would itself have thrown before printing its diagnostic.

The general form: a green `tsc --noEmit` on this repo is evidence about src/ and nothing else. Any claim of test-side correctness that leans on it is unfounded, and a gated live test that never runs in CI has no other mechanism that would catch the error.

SUCCESS
Type errors in test files fail a typecheck run.

SCOPE
tsconfig.json, or a second tsconfig for tests, plus whatever the resulting backlog requires. The quality-gate hook wiring if it invokes tsc with an explicit project.

NON_GOALS
No test rewrites beyond fixing type errors the widened check surfaces. No change to which tests run, to vitest configuration, or to the live-smoke gating.

CONSTRAINTS
Widening the include will surface an existing backlog of errors across tests/ — size it before committing to a single-commit fix. The build must not start emitting test files into dist. Vitest globals and the bun:sqlite / bun -e patterns used by the live tests must still typecheck.

VALIDATION
1. Reintroduce `host.snapshot(...)` in a test file and confirm the typecheck fails on it; revert.
2. `bunx tsc --noEmit` (or the project-specific invocation) reports zero errors with tests included.
3. `bun run build` output is unchanged — diff dist before and after.

OUTPUT
A typecheck that covers tests/, with the surfaced errors fixed or explicitly triaged.

SCRUTINY
LOW for the config change itself. MEDIUM for the backlog it exposes: a silenced error is worse than an unchecked one.
source.title: tsconfig excludes tests, so no test file is ever typechecked
